data.name: SetPrivacyLyrics
data.value: With synced lyrics on, Machitan sends the playing song's title, artist and length to LRCLIB (lrclib.net) to find its lyrics, and for a Winamp-style player the words of its file name when nothing else is found. A .lrc file next to the song is read on this PC.

data.value: Battery, network and volume come from Windows on this PC. The Wi-Fi name comes from Windows' network list, so no location permission is needed.

data.name: SetPrivacyShelf
data.value: What you park on Dynaland's shelf, in {0}: the paths of files and folders (only the paths: nothing is copied), and links and text as they are. Nothing leaves this PC.

data.name: SetPrivacyUpdates
data.value: When updates are checked (at start and once a day while that is on, and when you check), Machitan asks GitHub (api.github.com) for its newest release, so GitHub sees this PC's internet address and Machitan's version. An update is downloaded from GitHub only when you say so.

data.name: SetPrivacyWeather
data.value: With weather on in the info line, or a Weather widget shown, Machitan asks Windows for this PC's location at most once an hour, rounds it to about 1 km, and sends it to Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) every 15 minutes. If Windows blocks location for desktop apps, the weather stays hidden. With a place you picked, its rounded coordinates go instead, and a place search sends the name you typed to Open-Meteo. Nothing else leaves this PC.

data.name: SetPrivacyWidgets
data.value: The widgets you add, what you type in notes, and where and how big widgets are, in {0}. Nothing leaves this PC.
